summary: With --docker or --venv, unit test dependencies are installed for you; otherwise use --requirements. Lists unit test requirement files for tests and for ansible-test, plus the shared constraints file.
questions: How do I install the Python packages needed for Ansible unit tests?
Where is the list of unit test requirements for ansible-core?
Do I need to pip install anything to run units with --docker?

answer_card.title: Install unit test dependencies
answer_card.answer_md:
With `--docker` or `--venv`, nothing to install manually. Otherwise:
```shell
ansible-test units --python 3.12 --requirements apache2_module
```
Requirement lists: `test/units/requirements.txt` (the tests) and `test/lib/ansible_test/_data/requirements/units.txt` (ansible-test itself). Constraints for all commands are in `test/lib/ansible_test/_data/requirements/constraints.txt`.
